verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only payment-enablement data services: ACH details, account owner verification, balance checks, payment-success prediction, and deposit/bill-payment switching. None of these is a documented pay-by-bank or payment-initiation API that moves funds from a connected account. Live geographies for such a product are also not stated. These adjacent features earn no credit, and payment initiation is a fair question for an open-finance provider, so the verdict is none rather than na.
